decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal to convert the property into four x two bedroom flats, would not maintain the variety of housing stock in the Borough as it would not provide for a family sized unit with the conversion. The proposal is considered to be overdevelopment of the site and would result in a poor quality of living accommodation for future occupiers due to a lack of amenity space. The proposal would not provide adequate light or noise insulation for the proposed front flat. Accordingly, the proposal is considered to be contrary to Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to flats), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, extension to basement at rear of property and conversion of ground floor and basement floor into two x two bed flats
